scope: Static deployment-template validation only. No services created, containers started, database lifecycle run, or email sent.

schema.retrieval: Exa web fetch; parsed JSON normalized into a local schema snapshot
schema.hash_scope: Exact bytes of the normalized local snapshot; not an HTTP response-byte hash

compose.fixture_kind: External disposable fixture with fake values; contains no real credentials
compose.topology_method: Parsed config --format json with the operations profile; checks ran without printing environment values

docker_build.reason: Managed task user cannot access unix:///var/run/docker.sock (operation not permitted). No daemon recovery or build attempted.

notes: Schema and Compose validation do not establish container runtime correctness, SMTP inbox delivery, production readiness, load capacity, backup recovery or provider provisioning.
